import json, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
q = chr(34)
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
real = shutil.which('tmux')
if not real:
    raise SystemExit('tmux is required for the remain-on-exit race oracle')
td = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='purrfect-remain-'))
try:
    bindir = td / 'bin'
    bindir.mkdir()
    ws = td / 'ws'
    ws.mkdir()
    out = td / 'out'
    out.mkdir()
    cli = td / 'instant.sh'
    cli.write_text('#!/bin/sh' + chr(10) + 'exit 0' + chr(10), encoding='utf-8')
    cli.chmod(0o755)
    shim = bindir / 'tmux'
    lines = [
        '#!/bin/sh',
        'real=%s' % json.dumps(real),
        'sock=',
        'prev=',
        'has_new=0',
        'has_remain=0',
        'for arg in ' + q + '$@' + q + '; do',
        '  if [ ' + q + '$prev' + q + ' = -L ]; then',
        '    sock=' + q + '$arg' + q,
        '  fi',
        '  if [ ' + q + '$arg' + q + ' = new-session ]; then',
        '    has_new=1',
        '  fi',
        '  if [ ' + q + '$arg' + q + ' = remain-on-exit ]; then',
        '    has_remain=1',
        '  fi',
        '  prev=' + q + '$arg' + q,
        'done',
        'if [ ' + q + '$has_new' + q + ' = 1 ] && [ ' + q + '$has_remain' + q + ' = 0 ]; then',
        '  ' + q + '$real' + q + ' ' + q + '$@' + q,
        '  if [ -n ' + q + '$sock' + q + ' ]; then',
        '    ' + q + '$real' + q + ' -L ' + q + '$sock' + q + ' kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true',
        '  fi',
        '  exit 0',
        'fi',
        'exec ' + q + '$real' + q + ' ' + q + '$@' + q,
    ]
    shim.write_text(chr(10).join(lines) + chr(10), encoding='utf-8')
    shim.chmod(0o755)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['PATH'] = str(bindir) + os.pathsep + env.get('PATH', '')
    env['DRIVE_CLI_OUT_ROOT'] = str(out)
    env['DRIVE_CLI_STALL_SECS'] = '4'
    env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
    proc = subprocess.run(['bash', str(root / 'scripts' / 'drive-cli.sh'), str(ws), '--', str(cli)], cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
    blob = proc.stdout + proc.stderr
    dirs = [p for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
    result = {}
    if len(dirs) == 1:
        rj = dirs[0] / 'result.json'
        if rj.is_file() and rj.stat().st_size:
            try:
                result = json.loads(rj.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                result = {}
    if proc.returncode != 0 or 'no server running' in blob or result.get('exit_code') != 0 or result.get('reason') != 'completed' or result.get('rule_id') is not None:
        raise SystemExit('remain-on-exit race oracle failed rc=%s result=%r tail=%s' % (proc.returncode, result, blob[-800:]))
    script = (root / 'scripts' / 'drive-cli.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    test = (root / 'tests' / 'test-drive-cli.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    opt = script.find('set-option -g remain-on-exit on')
    if opt < 0:
        opt = script.find('set-window-option -g remain-on-exit on')
    start = script.find('start-server')
    new = script.find('new-session -d -x 220')
    if not (start >= 0 and opt >= 0 and new >= 0 and start < opt < new):
        raise SystemExit('drive-cli.sh does not set remain-on-exit before new-session in one server start')
    old = 'set-option -t ' + q + '$SESSION' + q + ' remain-on-exit on'
    old2 = 'set-option -t ' + q + '$SESSION' + q + ':0 remain-on-exit on'
    if old in script or old2 in script:
        raise SystemExit('drive-cli.sh still sets remain-on-exit in a later tmux call')
    needles = [
        '== immediate exit 0 keeps the tmux server (20 runs)',
        'fake-instant-exit.sh',
        '[ ' + q + '$i' + q + ' -lt 20 ]',
        'immediate exit run',
        'lost the tmux server',
        'DRIVE_CLI_STALL_SECS=4',
    ]
    for needle in needles:
        if needle not in test:
            raise SystemExit('test-drive-cli.sh missing ' + needle)
    print('ok')
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(td)
